scores.tell: Lamp glass glow is soft, but the dark green metal has a slightly glossy, rendered turn and little cast shadow.
The chrome tubes have bright metallic streak highlights and a hard-edged tabletop shadow. They are glossier than real cards.
The chair has a soft form turn, but the rounded tube highlights and legs are a bit plasticky. The cast shadow on the floor is large and soft.
Bottle plastic has several sharp white highlights and a glassy sheen. The shading is more realistic than the real cards.
The helmet is a glossy sphere with a large sharp specular on the visor and a reflective floor. It reads as a statue or toy render.
Warm, smooth shading with soft shadows and gentle highlights. The bark is slightly textured.
The gloves have several sharp white blob highlights and a fairly deep form shadow. Otherwise the turn is smooth and close to the real cards.
The shading is gentle and the cast shadows are soft. The water sparkle is a little busy.
The orange rim has a glossy, inflated sheen and the dial is flat. The floor shadow is soft and the form turn is fine.
The chrome tubes have hard specular streaks. The shadow under the chair is firm and crisp.
